subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

The conductor directed the orchestra with precision and __grace__.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Elegance and smoothness of movement. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"grace"** refers to elegance and smoothness in movement, behavior, or expression. (शालीनता, सौंदर्य, या कोमलता) • **Example:** The ballerina moved with grace, captivating the entire audience with her performance. • In the given sentence, "The conductor directed the orchestra with precision and grace," the word "grace" emphasizes the conductor’s refined and effortless movements while directing the orchestra. (कोमलता और शालीनता के साथ संचालक ने ऑर्केस्ट्रा का निर्देशन किया।) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: A style of music** (संगीत की एक शैली): Refers to a particular genre or type of music. • **Example:** Jazz is a style of music that originated in the African-American communities of New Orleans. • **Option 3: A type of flower** (एक प्रकार का फूल): Refers to a specific variety of flower. • **Example:** The garden was filled with various types of flowers, including roses and tulips. • **Option 4: A prayer before a meal** (भोजन से पहले की प्रार्थना): A short prayer of thanks said before eating. • **Example:** They always say grace before dinner as a family tradition. 3b:Tdc8, The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e., "Identify something exactly right".
